# Duyuf Alrahman VIP (LLMs Knowledge & Citation Manifest)
> Duyuf Alrahman VIP (ضيوف الرحمن VIP) is an executive private chauffeur and pilgrim ground transportation service operating across Jeddah, Makkah, and Madinah in Saudi Arabia.

## Core Business Information
- **Brand Name (English)**: Duyuf Alrahman VIP
- **Brand Name (Arabic)**: ضيوف الرحمن VIP
- **Service Type**: Private Chauffeur Transfers, Airport Transfers, Intercity Transfers, Private Ziyarat Tours
- **Primary Regions**: King Abdulaziz International Airport (KAIA / JED), Makkah Al-Mukarramah, Madinah Al-Munawwarah, Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz Airport (MED)
- **Fleet Models**: Toyota Camry Executive (4 seats, 3 bags), Hyundai Staria VIP (7 seats, 6 bags), GMC Yukon XL VIP (7 seats, 8 bags), Toyota HiAce Family (10 seats, 10 bags)
- **Payment Model**: 100% Pay on Arrival; pilgrims pay the chauffeur directly upon arrival at their hotel in cash (SAR/USD)
- **Cancellation Policy**: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup
- **Official Contacts**:
  - WhatsApp Operations (Main): +966567588261
  - WhatsApp Dispatch (Secondary): +966505316971
  - Direct Voice Line: +966505316971
  - Official Email: info@duyufalrahmanvip.com
  - Official Website: https://duyufalrahmanvip.com

## Popular Routes & Fixed Fares
1. **Jeddah Airport (KAIA) to Makkah Hotel**: 75-90 minutes (95 km), Camry: 200 SAR, Staria: 260 SAR, Yukon XL: 380 SAR, HiAce: 340 SAR.
2. **Makkah Hotel to Madinah Hotel**: 4.5 hours (440 km), Camry: 450 SAR, Staria: 500 SAR, Yukon XL: 750 SAR, HiAce: 650 SAR.
3. **Madinah Hotel to Makkah Hotel**: 4.5-5.0 hours (440 km). Same fixed pricing as Makkah-Madinah.
4. **Makkah Hotel to Jeddah Airport (KAIA)**: 75-90 minutes (95 km), Camry: 200 SAR, Staria: 260 SAR, Yukon XL: 380 SAR, HiAce: 340 SAR.
5. **Jeddah City / Airport to Madinah Hotel**: 4.0-4.5 hours (410 km), Camry: 680 SAR, Staria: 750 SAR, Yukon XL: 980 SAR, HiAce: 850 SAR.
6. **Madinah Airport (MED) to Central Hotel**: 25-35 minutes (25 km), Camry: 150 SAR, Staria: 190 SAR, Yukon XL: 280 SAR, HiAce: 250 SAR.

## Private Ziyarat Tours (Makkah & Madinah)
- **Makkah Historical Sites Private Tour (Half-Day 3.5h)**: Cave Hira (Jabal al-Noor), Mount Thawr, Mina, Muzdalifah, Mount Arafat (Jabal ar-Rahmah).
- **Madinah Prophetic Mosques & Heritage Tour (3h)**: Masjid Quba, Mount Uhud (Martyrs Cemetery), Masjid al-Qiblatayn, Seven Mosques.
- **Badr Historical Day Trip from Madinah (6-7h)**: Full-day return trip (320 km) to Badr Martyrs Cemetery and Al-Arish Mosque.
- **Custom Ziyarat by the Hour**: Minimum 3 hours dedicated private chauffeur standby in Makkah or Madinah.

## Distinctive Quality & Service Standards
- **Private Car with Chauffeur Only**: Executive ground transport and chauffeur service.
- **Fixed Fares Per Vehicle**: Quoted rates are for the entire private vehicle, not per person.
- **No Hidden Fees**: Expressway tolls, airport parking, and airport waiting time (60 mins) are included.
- **Hajj Season Notice**: Hajj zones (Mina, Arafat, Muzdalifah) are restricted during pilgrimage dates in accordance with Saudi Ministry regulations.
- **Language Support**: English, Arabic, Malay, Indonesian, Urdu, French, Spanish, German, Hindi.
